evidence.quote: That's a bonus; it's an upsell.

observations.why: Enacts market-pricing by explicitly categorizing a feature in commercial tiered exchange terms (bonus/upsell).

evidence.quote: It's also a lot more work because of the maintenance around fraud, et cetera

observations.why: Weighs operational maintenance burden against value delivery, using cost-benefit proportionality.

evidence.quote: I think SMS is something that we should offer only for the enterprise plan, because we have to provision numbers individually and manage them and so on and so forth.

observations.why: Frames tier-gating based directly on marginal operational cost and maintenance overhead.

evidence.quote: I'm doing this as a demo right now, and I'm trying to get some of these larger clients on the hook

observations.why: Explicit commercial instrumental framing of ongoing interactions with potential enterprise buyers.
